mapper.select: select id, user_id, packet_id, order_no, submit_token, type, amount, currency, status, notify_url, return_url, payment_url, trade_no, paid_amount, paid_currency, paid_at, success_at, created_at, updated_at, expired_at from xray_payment_order where order_no = #{orderNo}

select id, user_id, packet_id, order_no, submit_token, type, amount, currency, status, notify_url, return_url, payment_url, trade_no, paid_amount, paid_currency, paid_at, success_at, created_at, updated_at, expired_at from xray_payment_order where submit_token = #{submitToken}
mapper.update: update xray_payment_order set status = 'SUCCESS', trade_no = #{tradeNo}, paid_amount = #{paidAmount}, paid_currency = #{paidCurrency}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, success_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() where order_no = #{orderNo} and status != 'SUCCESS'
update xray_payment_order set status = 'CLOSED', updated_at = NOW() where status = 'PENDING' and expired_at is not null and expired_at <= NOW()
